artifacts.sourceMapInterpretation: The 66 absent SRI-manifest entries are 65 .js.map files and one .css.map file, all under .next/static. Separately, 144 source-map files were counted as present in the completed .next tree; their individual paths/types were not retained. Local next.config.ts uses withSentryConfig with widenClientFileUpload:true and no deleteSourcemapsAfterUpload override. Locked and locally installed @sentry/nextjs is 10.69.0: webpack.js enables server source-map/client hidden-source-map production devtools when not disabled and defaults client deleteSourcemapsAfterUpload to true when unset; getBuildPluginOptions selects .next/static/**/* source-map extensions for deletion after upload. This source behavior is consistent with the missing static maps but no retained trace proves upload/deletion occurred. The maps are non-executable. The Next default alone does not explain these missing files.
artifacts.ssgManifestInterpretation: _ssgManifest.js is generated after webpack compilation by Next build finalization; its emitted digest differs from the compilation-time SRI entry. The app uses App Router only (no pages directory), and it was absent from the two inspected HTTP responses and their initial script references. Do not weaken executable-asset SRI; the artifact mismatch remains unresolved and no correction is justified by the inspected runtime scope.
